title: Silver Saver Account: Transferring funds to external banks
summary: This document explains Silver Saver Account transfers to external banks: standard external transfers typically complete in 2 business days, while outgoing domestic wire transfers cost a 20 fee. It also covers when to choose each method and how to schedule and track transfers via the activity view and receipt confirmation.
